question: The second annual session of the Indian National Congress was held at which of the following places?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcutta.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** second annual session** of the Indian National Congress was held in** Calcutta.**
 
• Indian National Congress (INC) is one of the **oldest political parties** in India, founded in **1885.**
 
• It played a significant role in India's** struggle for independence **from British colonial rule.
 
• INC has produced several prominent political leaders, including **Jawaharlal Nehru, Indira Gandhi, and Rahul Gandhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bombay** (now Mumbai) hosted the **first session** of the Indian National Congress in **1885.**
 
• **Delhi** became the capital of India in **1911, **and it was not a major center of political activity during the early years of the Indian National Congress.
 
• **Madras** (now Chennai) hosted the **third session** of the Indian National Congress in** 1887.**
 
• An important milestone in the fight for Indian independence from** British control** was reached in** December 1926** when the Indian National Congress conducted its** 41st session in Guwahati, Assam**.
 
• The All-India Congress Committee meeting was arranged in Pandu Nagar, Guwahati, by** Tarun Ram Phukan.**
